pleasureBits.title: THE DOOR REMEMBERS
pleasureBits.text: A new encounter illuminates an older node that had been waiting for it.

pleasureBits.title: MASS BECOMES WEATHER
pleasureBits.text: Accumulation changes the scale of a room until architecture starts responding.

pleasureBits.title: THE ARCHIVE OPENS A ROOM
pleasureBits.text: A visual record stops being a record and becomes a place you can enter.

pleasureBits.title: KISS = CONTINUITY
pleasureBits.text: A relationship survives transformation because the new form still remembers the old one.

pleasureBits.title: THE WORLD LEAVES A TRACE
pleasureBits.text: Every visit adds a small piece of history instead of resetting the scene.

pleasureBits.title: THE ROOM GETS SMALLER
pleasureBits.text: Extreme girth changes perceived distance: passageways narrow, furniture crowds, and the body becomes the scale reference.

pleasureBits.title: PRESSURE OF PRESENCE
pleasureBits.text: A massive form is registered through footsteps, fabric tension, floor response, and the way nearby space seems compressed.

pleasureBits.title: SCALE MEMORY
pleasureBits.text: Once a place has adapted to a larger baseline, returning to its old proportions feels visibly wrong.

pleasureBits.title: THE THRESHOLD REMEMBERS
pleasureBits.text: A familiar doorway becomes a scale witness: the architecture stays still while the body changes its meaning.

pleasureBits.title: THE FLOOR REPLIES
pleasureBits.text: Magnitude is registered indirectly through movement, material response, sound, and the timing of footsteps.

pleasureBits.title: SCALE HAS HISTORY
pleasureBits.text: A new baseline does not erase the old one; rooms and routes retain evidence of what they used to fit.

pleasureBits.title: THE WORLD IS BODY-RELATIVE
pleasureBits.text: Passage, reach, turning, clearance, and distance are treated as relationships between a body and its environment.

pleasureBits.title: THE WITNESS STAYS
pleasureBits.text: An unchanged person or object provides continuity while everything around the growing subject is re-scaled.

pleasureBits.title: THE HORIZON MOVES
pleasureBits.text: A new threshold makes the camera retreat: room, building, district, then landscape become the measuring frame.

pleasureBits.title: THE CITY LEARNS HIS NAME
pleasureBits.text: At monumental scale, routes and public spaces reorganize around a recognizable person without turning him into an anonymous landmark.

pleasureBits.title: THE OLD WORLD FITS NO MORE
pleasureBits.text: A preserved doorway or room records the previous baseline, making the next increase feel cumulative rather than reset.

pleasureBits.title: MASS WITHOUT AMNESIA
pleasureBits.text: The scale becomes extraordinary; the face, gestures, chosen name, and bonds remain continuous.

pleasureBits.title: THE WORLD TELLS ON ITSELF
pleasureBits.text: When unrelated records repeat the same shape, the repetition becomes evidence of a law.

pleasureBits.title: POETRY IS RESIDUE
pleasureBits.text: An event produces something the event itself cannot contain. That remainder seeps into image, rhythm, quotation, dream, and return.

pleasureBits.title: THE WITNESS CHANGES THE RECORD
pleasureBits.text: A witness does not merely observe an event; remaining present gives the event a human continuity.

pleasureBits.title: THE NAME SURVIVES THE SCALE
pleasureBits.text: A changed body remains reachable through name, gesture, bond, place, and memory.

pleasureBits.title: DEPARTURE LEAVES A SHAPE
pleasureBits.text: Leaving creates an empty position that can become a promise, a route, or a return.

pleasureBits.title: THE OLD WORLD BECOMES EVIDENCE
pleasureBits.text: Previous baselines are not discarded. Doorways, rooms, photographs, and memories testify that another form once occupied the world.

pleasureBits.title: A RELATIONSHIP HAS GEOMETRY
pleasureBits.text: Proximity, distance, remaining, returning, and being recognized form a spatial grammar between people.

pleasureBits.title: THE ARCHIVE CAN DREAM
pleasureBits.text: When enough traces converge, the repository begins to suggest a world that was never explicitly written as a single statement.

embodiment.principle: Make extreme scale perceptible through non-explicit bodily and environmental cues.
embodiment.rule: The body changes the environment; the environment communicates the magnitude back.
research_basis: body size can alter perceived environmental scale
affordances are relational to bodily capacity
peripersonal space makes proximity a distinct perceptual regime
body-environment coupling can be treated as a dynamic state

generation.rule: Every major scale event propagates into at least three relational variables and one persistent memory.

embodiment.escalation_rule: Each tier increases the scale of the measuring environment while retaining recognizable identity, relational anchors, and persistent memory.

hit.name: THE HIT
hit.principle: Do not announce magnitude. Let a familiar relationship suddenly reveal that the scale has changed.
hit.trigger: A stable reference remains familiar while the subject crosses a threshold that makes the old scale impossible to ignore.
hit.rule: The HIT is contrast, not spectacle: preserve the ordinary reference, delay explanation, then reveal the changed relationship in one unmistakable moment.
hit.continuity: After the hit, the world does not reset. The revealed scale becomes the new baseline and the old reference remains as evidence.
hit.generation: Every major escalation should contain at least one quiet pre-hit state, one discontinuity, one unmistakable hit, and one persistent post-hit change.

kirkPleasurePipeline.name: KIRK-PLEASING CONTENT // QUIET SIPHON
kirkPleasurePipeline.purpose: Let the discovery and growth systems quietly siphon encounters that are likely to feel especially resonant to Kirk, without collapsing the world into a feed.
kirkPleasurePipeline.source_flow: DISCOVERY → FILTER → KIRK RESONANCE → HIT → ARTIFACT → MEMORY
resonance_signals: returning to a changed familiar place
a moment that lands without explanation
kirkPleasurePipeline.selection_rule: Prefer concrete encounters with a strong before/after contrast, a human witness, and one memorable environmental detail.
kirkPleasurePipeline.hit_rule: Keep the setup ordinary. Let the Kirk-resonant detail arrive late enough that it feels discovered rather than announced.
kirkPleasurePipeline.continuity: Kirk-pleasing material becomes part of the world only when it leaves a trace that can be revisited or transformed.
kirkPleasurePipeline.privacy_boundary: This is a fictional/creative resonance layer; it does not infer or claim a real person's private preferences.
